subject: Post-signature assimilation plan: blue/green deployment, canary cadence & training
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Blake <erin.blake@ziplinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature assimilation plan: blue/green deployment, canary cadence & training

Hi Erin —

Great to have Zipline on board. Attached is the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) that embeds the post-signature implementation plan. Key sections: rollout phases (pre-canary, canary, scaled-rollout), blue/green cutover steps, canary cadence with guardrail metrics, migration checklist, and a proposed training week.

As a first pass, can you confirm the following by EOD today so we can lock scheduling with infra and docs teams:
- Canary window preference (overnight vs business hours) and desired ramp profile (we propose 2% -> 10% over 48h)
- White-box acceptance criteria (latency P95 < 300ms, error rate < 0.5% on the canary cohort)
- Training week availability (we've penciled July 12-16 for instructor-led sessions and role-based walkthroughs)

What we'll do internally once you confirm: reserve dedicated nodes for the canary, prepare the KV-cache warmup run, and publish the scoped smoke-test plan.

Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan + implementation workbook)

Thanks — looking forward to getting the first cohort live.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

From: Erin Blake <erin.blake@ziplinehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature assimilation plan: blue/green deployment, canary cadence & training

Thanks Sean — and congrats team, excited to get started. Quick answers below: 

- Canary window: Prefer a business-hours canary for visibility across our on-call and product teams. Start Tue 12:00 PT, ramp 1% -> 5% (12h) -> 10% (24h). If metrics look stable at 10% for 24h, proceed to 25% next day.
- Acceptance criteria: agree to P95 < 350ms (we're slightly more conservative than your proposal), error < 0.3% on critical endpoints (inference/generation), and no increase in customer-facing 5xxs.
- Training: July 12-16 works; prefer July 13 for an in-depth runbook walkthrough and July 15 for role-based drills.

A couple of asks from procurement/security: we need the SOC2 evidence package and a short note on data retention for inference logs (30 days by default). I'll share the internal procurement ticket this afternoon.

Erin
Director, Platform Integrations
Zipline Health
erin.blake@ziplinehealth.com

Subject: Internal: Zipline MAP — owners, infra reservations, smoke tests

Team — looping in runbook/ops owners. Summary of Erin's replies and our next internal steps (action owners below):

Quoted from Erin: "Prefer a business-hours canary: start Tue 12:00 PT, ramp 1% -> 5% (12h) -> 10% (24h)... P95 < 350ms, error < 0.3% on critical endpoints... SOC2 evidence + note on 30d inference log retention."

Actions: 
- Karthik: reserve dedicated canary pool (2x gpus, reserved for 72h) and set up blue/green toggle; verify that we can do traffic slicing at the LB layer. Due: 2026-07-02 EOD.
- Grace: prepare the canary-checklist.pdf (platform smoke tests, metric dashboards, alert thresholds, rollback triggers). Target draft: 2026-07-01.
- Sean: own the MAP updates and coordinate training week logistics with Customer Success. Add the runbook link to the MAP.
- Monica: coordinate SOC2 evidence handoff to Erin and confirm data-retention language with Security.

Smoke-test highlights to include in the checklist: cold-start latency, kv-cache hit-rate warmup, partial-request timeouts, token cost delta for sampled inputs, canary user session integrity. Rollback criteria: sustained P95 degradation > 20% vs baseline OR error spike > 0.5% for 15min.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aZ-zipline-onboarding

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature assimilation plan: blue/green deployment, canary cadence & training

Erin — thanks for the quick confirmation. We're aligned on business-hours canary and training week. A couple of clarifications from our side before we lock calendars: 

1) Metrics we'll publish to you in real-time during the canary: per-endpoint P95, 99, error-rate, request/second, and a custom "generation-quality" sampling tag we will send to a small cohort for manual review.
2) Rollback triggers (automated):
   - automated rollback if P95 > 400ms for two consecutive 10-min windows, OR
   - error rate > 0.6% sustained for 10 minutes.
3) Manual rollback: on-call product owner or Zipline product lead can initiate immediate rollback via the runbook steps. We will run a dry-run of rollback on July 8 (no traffic) to verify automation.

Attachment: canary-checklist.pdf (draft)

Next steps: we will schedule the runbook walkthrough (July 13, 10:00 PT) and the role-based drills (July 15, 14:00 PT). Sean — please confirm attendee list for the training and I'll add the infra invites once reservations are done.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Head of Dedicated Deployments
Redwood Inference
